newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche BA sells turboprop planes to French group.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche BA sells turboprop planes to French group.

text.p: Deutsche BA, the German subsidiary of British Airways PLC said on Monday it had signed a letter of intent to sell all its turboprop planes to France's Regional Airlines.
Deutsche BA said in a statement the decision was part of a plan to concentrate on its core business.
It said Regional Airlines intended to set up a German subsidiary which would operate independently using Deutsche BA's five Saab 2000 aircraft.

The network currently comprises 10 inner-German and international routes from Friedrichshafen, Stuttgart and Bremen. There are currently 184 people employed in this area and the airline said these jobs would be retained.
Deutsche BA carried 298,000 passengers in its regional network in 1995.
It gave no financial details for the transaction.
